paragraphs: We started SaudinTech with one mission: to make professional software solutions accessible to businesses of every size in Saudi Arabia.

Our founding team brings together deep software engineering expertise and hands-on business development experience. That combination is rare — and it's exactly what makes the difference when building systems that need to work in real business environments.
We don't just write code. We understand operations, customers, and the challenges that come with running a business in Saudi Arabia.

pillars.title: Our Mission
pillars.text: Make enterprise-quality software accessible and affordable for every Saudi business.

pillars.title: Our Vision
pillars.text: A Saudi Arabia where every small business competes with the tools of enterprise companies.

faq.title: Common Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your project with us.

items.q: How much does a website or software cost?
items.a: Every project is different and we price based on complexity and scope. A basic business website starts from SAR 3,000 while a full inventory or POS system starts from SAR 8,000. We offer flexible payment options and always provide a detailed proposal before you commit.

A business website typically takes 2–4 weeks. A custom system such as inventory management or CRM takes 6–12 weeks depending on complexity. We provide a detailed timeline upfront and keep you updated throughout the project.

items.q: Do you provide ongoing support after launch?
items.a: Absolutely. We offer monthly maintenance and support packages to keep your system running smoothly, secure, and up to date. We don't disappear after delivery — long-term support is part of every engagement.

items.q: Can the software be customized or updated later?
items.a: Yes — this is one of the key advantages of custom software. Because we build it specifically for you, adding features, changing workflows, or scaling to new branches is entirely possible. Your system evolves with your business.

items.q: Do you support Arabic language in your systems?
items.a: Yes, fully. All our systems are built with both Arabic and English support including proper RTL layout for Arabic. Your staff can use the system in their preferred language without any limitations.

items.q: Can you build something specific to my industry?
items.a: That's what we do best. We don't sell generic software — we build systems designed for your specific type of business, your workflows, your team, and your customers. Book a free consultation and we'll discuss exactly what would work for you.
